rationale: The workflow already implements the applicable evidence-supported optimizations: concurrency with cancel-in-progress (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE) supersedes stale runs, every job has an explicit timeout-minutes (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT), ccache/sccache dependency caching is present in the relevant jobs (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE), and push/pull_request triggers are already path-filtered (P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER). The remaining candidate, P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (setting matrix fail-fast: true), would cancel remaining matrix cells after a failure, reducing build/test coverage across the compiler and build-type matrix. That conflicts with the requirement to preserve intended build and test coverage and with the pattern contraindication that every matrix outcome is required; its supporting evidence is also synthetic rather than measured on this repository. No safe, coverage-preserving optimization remains to apply.
